title: NPC Portrait Wiring — Complete URL Set for Character Pages
description: Wire NPC portraits into character/zone pages on geodeinn.com. Each character has up to 3 frequency states: Living (default), Shadow (84Hz), and In-Between (transitional). All URLs are live CDN images.
instructions: On each zone page, display NPCs assigned to that zone with their Living portrait as default
Add a frequency toggle (Living / Shadow / In-Between) on character detail views — three thumbnails swap when toggled
If a character only has Living, show that without a toggle
Portraits should be displayed in the antiqued gold/brass bordered frame style matching the site aesthetic
Character names only — no pronouns (standing design rule)
On the /world-map page, use Living portraits as map pin popups for NPCs located in each zone
